authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6849 distinguishes dhūma smoke, with dhuā̃/dhuwā̃, from section 2 dhūmikā, expressly containing Palula dhūmī. The exact parent is chosen accordingly. Forms with unexplained k or intervocalic h need separate comparison. Reviewed comparison: Goj dʰumā “smoke” (f_pgyrnhojbfqoe). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3865 khādati gives khā-/khāv-/khāvan eat, including Palula khūm. Section 2 khādita expressly includes Nepali khāyo ate; the Dotyali past is assigned to that participle. Unclear p-bearing responses are held. Reviewed comparison: Phal kʰā “eat” (f_smy3sl7bma6y4). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
